items.headline: Bellingham's Brace Sends England Past Norway in Extra Time
items.body: England secured a hard-fought 2-1 extra-time victory over Norway, with Jude Bellingham scoring both goals for the Three Lions. Erling Haaland netted for Norway, but his efforts were not enough to prevent England from advancing to the semifinals. The match was a tense affair, pushing both teams to their limits.

items.headline: Three Lions' Resilience Shines Against Haaland's Threat
items.body: England's tactical setup focused on containing Erling Haaland, a strategy that ultimately paid off in extra time. The midfield battle, particularly between Declan Rice and Martin Odegaard, was pivotal in controlling the tempo and creating opportunities. England's defensive solidity, combined with Bellingham's attacking prowess, proved decisive.

items.headline: Bellingham and Haaland: A Duel of Golden Boot Contenders
items.body: Jude Bellingham's two goals were a testament to his elite-level performance, showcasing his ability to deliver in critical moments. Erling Haaland, despite his goal, was largely marshaled by the English defense, highlighting the challenge of breaking down top-tier opposition. Both players remain key figures in the Golden Boot race.

items.headline: Messi Magic: Mac Allister Header Secures Argentina's Semifinal Berth
items.body: Argentina edged past a resilient Switzerland side with a narrow 1-0 victory, thanks to an early header from Alexis Mac Allister. The decisive goal came in the 10th minute from a perfectly delivered corner kick by captain Lionel Messi. Switzerland's disciplined defense made it a challenging encounter for the reigning champions.

metadata.venue: Kansas City Stadium, Kansas City, USA

items.headline: Swiss Wall Tested by Messi's Vision
items.body: Switzerland's organized defensive structure proved difficult to break down, forcing Argentina to rely on a set-piece moment of brilliance. Lionel Messi's exceptional delivery from the corner was the key, demonstrating his enduring impact even when direct attacking play is stifled. Argentina showed resilience to secure the win against a stubborn opponent.

items.headline: Mac Allister's Decisive Strike from Messi's Corner
items.body: Alexis Mac Allister's early goal, assisted by Lionel Messi, was the singular moment of breakthrough in a tightly contested match. This combination highlights the importance of set-pieces and individual brilliance at this stage of the tournament. Messi continues to be a central figure in Argentina's attacking plays.

sections.title: Road to Glory: Semifinalists' Form and Fitness

items.headline: England and Argentina Punch Tickets to the Elite Four
items.body: England showcased their fighting spirit by overcoming Norway in extra time, demonstrating strong form and mental fortitude. Argentina, while not dominant, found a way to win against a tough Swiss side, relying on their star power. Both teams enter the semifinals with momentum, albeit through different paths.

items.headline: Injury Concerns Loom for Semifinal Contenders
items.body: France faces concerns over Kylian Mbappé's minor ankle injury, though he is expected to play, alongside doubts for Kouadio Kone and Aurélien Tchouaméni. Spain has Nico Williams and Yeremy Pino doubtful. England's Declan Rice, Marc Guehi, and Reece James are reportedly fit after recent issues, while Argentina monitors Cristian Romero's knee.

items.headline: Historical Paths Converge for Semifinal Showdowns
items.body: England's victory marks their fourth-ever World Cup semifinal appearance, showcasing their consistent presence at the tournament's sharp end. Argentina, as reigning champions, continue their quest to become the first back-to-back winners since Brazil in 1962, adding another chapter to their storied World Cup history.

items.headline: France vs. Spain: A European Derby in the Semifinals
items.body: The first semifinal will see European powerhouses France and Spain clash on July 14. This highly anticipated matchup pits two of the tournament's strongest sides against each other for a place in the final.

items.headline: Recent History Favors La Roja in France-Spain Rivalry
items.body: Spain holds a recent advantage over France, having defeated them in the semifinals of both Euro 2024 and the 2025 Nations League. This history sets the stage for a compelling tactical battle, with both teams eager to assert dominance on the biggest stage.

items.headline: Mbappé's Firepower Meets Spain's Control and Super-Subs
items.body: France's potent attack, spearheaded by Kylian Mbappé, will challenge Spain's renowned possession-based football and their ability to introduce game-changing players like Mikel Merino and Lamine Yamal from the bench. The midfield battle will be crucial in determining control and creating scoring opportunities.

items.headline: England vs. Argentina: A Classic World Cup Rivalry Renewed
items.body: The second semifinal on July 15 will feature a historic clash between England and Argentina, a matchup steeped in World Cup lore. Both teams will be vying for a spot in the coveted final.

items.headline: Decades-Long Feud Ignites Again
items.body: England and Argentina share a decades-long rivalry in World Cup history, marked by memorable and often controversial encounters. This semifinal adds another chapter to their intense footballing narrative, promising a passionate contest.

items.headline: Kane and Bellingham vs. Messi's Enduring Genius
items.body: England's robust defense and the combined attacking threat of Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham will face Argentina's tactical adaptability and the unparalleled brilliance of Lionel Messi. Argentina's proven ability to navigate high-pressure knockout games will be a key factor against England's disciplined approach.
